elements.text: Detailed evidence atlas: what is actually available
Chandrayaan-3 terrain reconstruction  |  Detailed evidence: 10 Nov 2026

Result inventory	Visible evidence	Interpretation
50 accepted local observations	Source image + full mesh for every observation	Observed, open surfaces
6 registered groups	Actual fused meshes + support counts	Local relative alignment
3 × 3 completion variants	Balanced / extended / simulation surfaces	Measured + inferred terrain
2 generated stereo trials	Strict / relaxed + 7 profiles each	Camera gate failed; arbitrary scale
15 saved video-derived surfaces	Mesh + labels + frames + result tables	Procedural controls / hypotheses
2 invalid temporal controls	Actual candidate meshes + failure counts	Acceptance weaknesses remain
12 learned-model families are planned; no learned-generator result is available in this snapshot.
